scope: Read-only public HTTPS crawl, downloaded-file comparison and six mobile browser checks. No forms submitted and no server configuration or private files accessed.

findings.description: Returns the old black/white Vercel triangle placeholder. The favicon explicitly linked by pages is valid Nikki artwork; the browser fallback and declared icon disagree.
findings.local_fix: Map the root favicon to the existing branded ICO, remove the unused placeholder locally, and use versioned icon links on all pages.

findings.description: The default Apple icon URLs return 404. The dedicated assets/icons/favicons/apple-touch-icon.png is valid. Blog pages declared only an ICO, without an Apple touch icon or manifest.
findings.local_fix: Resolve both default URLs to the existing Apple icon and declare Apple/PNG/ICO/manifest links consistently on all 58 HTML pages.

findings.description: Manifest JSON and its icon images load, but the manifest is served as text/plain.
